channel.title: DD&SA Essays
channel.description: Structural analyses of representation, trust, deliberation, sortition, and democratic design — from Direct Democracy & Sortition Assemblies.

item.title: Opinion and Deliberation – Two Different Things
item.description: An examination of the difference between opinion and deliberation, and why democracy depends on structured, evidence-based deliberation, not raw preference.

item.title: Direct Democracy – Why Direct Voting and Sortition Must Operate Together
item.description: An examination of how direct voting complements sortition assemblies in the DD&SA model, and why the two mechanisms must operate together to maintain legitimacy.

item.title: The Limits of Elections – A Structural Critique
item.description: A structural examination of what elections can and cannot do, and why relying on elections alone cannot deliver deep democratic legitimacy or long-term governance.

item.title: Representative Democracy – A Structural Examination
item.description: An examination of the structural limits of representative democracy and why trust continues to decline across modern systems.

item.title: Why Sortition Works – A Structural Analysis
item.description: An examination of sortition as a democratic mechanism, and why random selection produces more representative, honest, and deliberative decision-making.

item.title: Structural Honesty – Why Systems Shape Truth
item.description: An examination of structural honesty: why systems shape truth-telling, and why honesty depends on incentives, not personal virtue.

item.title: System Design – A Systems-Engineering Perspective on DD&SA
item.description: A systems-engineering perspective on DD&SA: feedback loops, failure modes, transparency requirements, and the logic of distributed authority.

item.title: Why Trust Declines – A Structural Diagnosis
item.description: An examination of why trust in democratic institutions declines, and why the causes are structural rather than emotional or cultural.

item.title: Truth in Public Life – Why Truth Collapses Under Party Competition
item.description: An examination of why truth collapses under party competition, and how DD&SA restores a shared factual basis for public decision-making.
